title: [Shopify] Add Compare-at Price field to Shopify Variants page for personalization
summary: The Shopify Variants page now includes a Compare at Price field control for personalization, allowing users to display and review the Shopify compare-at price for variants.
key_points: Added Compare at Price field control to the Shopify Variants page
Field is hidden by default to preserve existing layouts
Users can enable it through personalization options
Corresponds to field 7 in the Shpfy Variant table
Positioned after the Price field on the page
